title: reprise
description: Un-flatten any flat AI design into editable layers, reproduce it bit-perfect, from your agent.
summary: Un-flatten any flat AI design into editable layers, reproduce it bit-perfect, from your agent.
offersHint: Un-flatten any flat AI design into editable layers, reproduce it bit-perfect, from your agent. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://tepesama-reprise-mcp.hf.space/gradio_api/mcp/http

toolsPreview.name: reproduce
toolsPreview.description: Un-flatten a flat design image into editable layers and reproduce it bit-perfect, returning the fidelity score. Returns: A JSON string with a bit_perfect flag and fidelity metrics (mae, psnr, exact-match %, stray px).

toolsPreview.name: autodetect
toolsPreview.description: Auto-detect the elements (subjects and text) in a design image as relative bounding boxes. Returns: A JSON string with the detected elements (relative bboxes) and their count.

toolsPreview.name: diagnose
toolsPreview.description: Score how faithfully a reproduction matches an original (MAE / PSNR / exact-match % / stray px). Returns: A JSON string with the fidelity metrics.
